items.title: 33.4 Insani sargarmiyon se pani ki aaloodgi (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of water pollution due to human activities (PDF 254-255).

blocks.text: Insani sargarmiyan duniya bhar mein pani ki aaloodgi ki bari wajah hain. Aabadi barhne aur sanaton ke phailne se zyada kachra aur aaloodgi aabi zakhiron mein jati hai, aur kachre ka ghalat intizam aur kamzor mahol ke qawaneen aksar aaloodgi ko daryaon, jheelon aur samandaron tak pohancha dete hain.

items: Sanati sargarmiyan: pani ki aaloodgi ka bara zariya. Karkhane aksar nuqsan-deh kimiyai maddey, heavy metals aur zehreela kachra seedha daryaon, jheelon aur samandaron mein daalte hain; aaloodgi phailane wali aam sanaton mein tel ki refineries, kimiyai plants, gariyon ki sanat, khaad ke plants aur chamra rangne ke karkhane (tanneries) shamil hain.

Zarai sargarmiyan: behta pani khaad, pesticides aur herbicides qareebi paniyon tak le jata hai. Ghalat aabpashi mitti ka katao barhati aur tah ko daryaon aur naalon mein bahati hai, aur kheton ka nikas satah aur zameeni pani dono aaloodah karta hai.

Gharelu aur baladiyati kachra: shehron ka na saaf ya kam saaf sewage aur thos kachra aksar seedha daryaon, jheelon ya samandaron mein jata, jis se nuqsan-deh bacteria aur viruses aate hain. Gharelu detergents, tel aur kimiyai maddey naaliyon se aabi zakhiron tak pohanchte, aur naaliyon mein phenke plastics rukawat aur taveel aaloodgi paida karte hain.

Jangalat ki katai aur shehri taraqqi ke liye zameen ka istemal: darakht aur sabza hatne se dheeli mitti katti aur zyada tah daryaon mein jati, raaste band karti aur maskanon ko nuqsan deti; tameerat behte pani mein aaloodgi aur malba daalti hai.

Tafreehi sargarmiyan: kashti rani, tairaki aur camping intizam na ho to pani aaloodah kar sakti hain; kashtiyan tel, fuel aur kimiyai maddey chhorti, aur sayyah plastics, khane ke rapper aur doosra kachra phenkte hain.

Samandari naql-o-hamal: jahaz aur kashtiyan tel, fuel aur doosre kimiyai maddey chhorti hain; tel ka hadsati girna, jahazon ka ganda pani aur sewage, aur dhanche ki safai aur rang jaisi maamool ki dekh-bhaal zehreele maddey chhorti hai.

blocks.text: Aik darya teen ilaqon se guzarta hai: bare kheton aur bohat se maweshiyon wala dehi ilaqa; paint aur battery ki bohat si sanaton wala sanati ilaqa; aur bare shehar ka bara rihaishi ilaqa.

blocks.prompt: (i) Dehi ilaqa kaun si aaloodgi, organic, inorganic ya dono, daalega? Do naam batayein. (ii) Sanati ilaqe ke qareeb kaun si dhatein zyada mumkin hain?
blocks.explanation: (i) Dono: organic (maweshiyon ka gobar, pesticides) aur inorganic (NH4NO3 jaise nitrate aur phosphate khaad). (ii) Paints aur batteries se lead aur cadmium (aur mercury).

blocks.prompt: (iii) Kaun se ilaqe eutrophication karne wale kimiyai maddey daalenge? (iv) Rihaishi ilaqe ki chaar aaloodgiyan batayein.
blocks.explanation: (iii) Dehi ilaqa (khaad ka behta pani aur gobar) aur rihaishi ilaqa (sewage aur phosphate detergents). (iv) Maslan: bacteria aur viruses wala sewage, detergents, gharelu tel aur kimiyai maddey, aur plastics.

items: Insani zaraye: sanat (sab se bara), zaraat, gharelu aur baladiyati kachra, jangalat ki katai aur tameerat, tafreeh, samandari naql-o-hamal.
